```lean
theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} {s : Set α} : ∑ᶠ (i : α) (_ : i ∈ s), 1 = s.ncard := by
  haveI : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac
  rw [Set.ncard_eq_of_bijective]
  · exact id
  · intro x h
    exact ⟨x, h⟩
  · intro x h
    exact x
  · intro x h
    exact h
  · intro x y h1 h2
    exact Eq.eq_iff_true.mp (Eq.symm h1).mp h2
```
